title: The Power of Stories
text:
Many readers believe that a novel is simply a way to pass the time. However, a good story can change how we see the world around us. When we follow the life of a character, we often begin to understand feelings that we had never named before. This is why authors spend years choosing every word carefully.

In addition, literature can preserve the memory of a culture. Old poems and folk tales tell us how people once lived, what they feared, and what they hoped for. Therefore, reading these works is a way of listening to voices from the past. Some critics argue that this connection is the most valuable gift that literature offers.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do authors spend years doing?
According to the second paragraph, what can literature preserve?
What can be inferred about the author's view of reading?
options: The author believes reading can deepen our understanding of people.
The author believes reading is only useful for students.
The author believes stories have no effect on readers.
The author believes old poems are impossible to read today.

questions.text: Why might the author say that reading old works is like listening to voices from the past?
options: Because old works reveal how earlier people lived and felt.
Because old works are always read aloud in theaters.
Because old works were written by the same authors today.
Because old works are easier to understand than new ones.

paragraph_translations: Muchos lectores creen que una novela es simplemente una forma de pasar el tiempo. Sin embargo, una buena historia puede cambiar la manera en que vemos el mundo que nos rodea. Cuando seguimos la vida de un personaje, a menudo empezamos a comprender sentimientos que nunca habíamos nombrado. Por eso los autores dedican años a elegir cada palabra con cuidado.

Además, la literatura puede conservar la memoria de una cultura. Los poemas antiguos y los cuentos populares nos explican cómo vivía la gente, qué temía y qué esperaba. Por lo tanto, leer estas obras es una forma de escuchar las voces del pasado. Algunos críticos afirman que esta conexión es el regalo más valioso que ofrece la literatura.
